svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print in PETG at 100 % infill: 64 wide, 50 deep, 40 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot 20.4 x 40.4 mm top to bottom for the post (0.2 mm clear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side), its centre 13 mm right of the block's centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 18.4 mm front to back for the arm, 25 mm left of the post

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre and half way up, so the arm passes beside the post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print a hex pocket for an M6 nut and a 6.6 mm hole into the slot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and into the bore, each locked by an M6 thumb screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slides on the post; the arm slides through the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: slides freely when loose and does not move when locked.
